import json

issues={
'58b33e7b6f9b11424966092ff3bb95c53db99f66a0df7c633d9811f8ce1cc6b8':'原文为固定值 +10 闪电伤害，译文误加百分号成 +10% 闪电伤害。',

}

    i=x['entry_revision_identity']

assert len(set(x['entry_revision_identity'] for x in results))==20
assert s[0]=='{' and s[-1]=='}' and '\n' not in s
print(s,end='')
